description: Expand product catalog from 8 to 20 agricultural products with Unsplash images, covering 4 categories: Vegetables (7 products), Fruits (6), Rice & Grains (4), Root Crops (3). Add Root Crops category tab to UI. Each product has: id, name, category, price, unit, farmer, origin, tag, emoji, image (Unsplash URL), stock (random 10-100), description. This is independent of FEAT-001/002 but uses the same product schema that database.js will initialize.
steps: 1. Modify c:\MIdtermProject\anihan_market\app.js: expand the products array from 8 to 20 items
2. Keep existing 8 products: Fresh Pechay, Sweet Carabao Mangoes, Organic Tomatoes, Brown Rice, Sweet Lakatan Banana, Fresh Eggplant, Red Onions, Fresh Pineapple

3. Add 12 new products with Unsplash images:
   - Vegetables: Sitaw (string beans, https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1626436358362-cbfebde91c64?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Kangkong (water spinach, https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1515023115689-589c33041d3c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Ampalaya (bitter gourd, https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1631706128229-e59d6c9e6c68?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85)
   - Fruits: Papaya (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526318472351-c75fcf070305?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Watermelon (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1589984662646-e7b2e4962f18?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Calamansi (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1621264448270-9ef00e88a935?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85)
   - Rice & Grains: White Rice Sinandomeng (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1586201375761-83865001e31c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Palay Unmilled Rice (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1536304993881-ff6e9eefa2a6?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), White Corn (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551754655-cd27e38d2076?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85)
   - Root Crops: Kamote Sweet Potato (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1586201375761-83865001e31c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Gabi Taro (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1587049332358-d3c7e40f1b95?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85), Ube Purple Yam (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1604329760661-e71dc83f8f26?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=85)

4. Assign each new product: sequential id (9-20), appropriate farmer from existing 3 (Juan Dela Cruz, Maria Santos, Pedro Ramos), origin from Calapan/Victoria/Naujan Oriental Mindoro, price 40-150 pesos, appropriate unit (kg/bunch/piece/sack), tag (Farm fresh/Harvest today/Organic/etc), emoji, stock field (random 10-100)
5. Add description field to ALL 20 products (brief 1-sentence description, e.g., 'Crisp and fresh from our partner farms')

6. Modify c:\MIdtermProject\anihan_market\index.html: add Root Crops category button in .category-tabs div after Rice & grains button: <button class="category" data-category="Root Crops">🍠 Root Crops</button>
7. Verify category filter logic in app.js already handles the new category (it does — it checks p.category === selectedCategory)
acceptance_criteria: products array in app.js contains exactly 20 items
All 20 products have: id, name, category, price, unit, farmer, origin, tag, emoji, image, stock, description fields
7 products in Vegetables category: Pechay, Tomatoes, Eggplant, Red Onion, Sitaw, Kangkong, Ampalaya
6 products in Fruits category: Carabao Mango, Lakatan Banana, Pineapple, Papaya, Watermelon, Calamansi
4 products in Rice & Grains category: Brown Rice, White Rice Sinandomeng, Palay, White Corn
3 products in Root Crops category: Kamote, Gabi, Ube
Root Crops tab appears in category navigation
Clicking Root Crops tab filters to show only 3 root crop products
All product images load from Unsplash (or show emoji fallback if network fails)
Search and filter work correctly with 20 products
verification: 2. Verify 20 products display in 'All produce' view (4 rows of 5 on desktop, adjust for viewport)
6. Click '🌾 Rice & grains' tab — 4 products visible
7. Click '🍠 Root Crops' tab — 3 products visible (Kamote, Gabi, Ube)
8. Test search: type 'palay' — should show Palay product
9. Test search: type 'mango' — should show Carabao Mango
